hero.description: The College (near) and Curtis (far) Buildings of Thomas Jefferson University at 1025 Walnut Street between S. 10 and S. 11 Streets in Center City, Philadelphia was built in 1928-29 and was designed by Horace Trumbauer in the Romanesque Revial style. (Sources: Emporis and "A Modest Proposal: Some Rejected and Altered Architectural Designs for TJU Campus Buildings" on the TJU website)
